reason: Trial 2 was the strongest completed primary result (search accuracy 0.7552) using CatBoost with depth 6 and l2_leaf_reg 3.0. This candidate tests the registered native-category CatBoost route with matching core parameters.
review: The extra-trees trial overfit strongly (train 0.9946 vs search 0.7065), and logistic underperformed. CatBoost has the best primary evidence so far, while the native-category CatBoost route remains untried.
hypothesis: Native-category CatBoost with depth 6 and l2_leaf_reg 3.0 may retain the strong primary accuracy seen in trial 2 without relying on the exhausted field-interaction representation.
uncertainty: Trial 2 used a different representation (training-selected field interactions), so native-category performance is not guaranteed; no numerical improvement is predicted.
